description:
Priority: P1 (layout). File: tern/schema.sql (new). Reference: aviary/keystore/metricstore.

Problem: The template ships .tern/migrations/ (migration state) but no committed flat-schema snapshot, so there is nothing for a CI drift check to diff against.

Change: Run the new generate-schema task (TPL-006) against the template's migrations and commit the normalized output to tern/schema.sql.

Acceptance: tern/schema.sql exists and re-running generate-schema produces no diff.
Depends on: TPL-006. Unblocks: an optional schema-drift CI job later.
title: [TPL-015] Commit a generated tern/schema.sql snapshot
